title: Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi (Theme 9: Matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika biashara)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child tells KU of verbal nouns (kucheza kwake kunapendeza) from KU of place (shuleni kunapendeza) and uses pa-, ku-, mu- by place.
contexts: digital devices in business: kununua mtandaoni kunarahisisha

board.say: Ni ndani au mahali kwa jumla?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "kuna" and one KU-KU sentence.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Kusoma kinafurahisha." si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Hapa kuzuri." si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Humu pazuri." si jibu sahihi?
Neno hili ni shughuli au mahali?
misconceptions.repair: Kitenzi-jina ni shughuli; ku- ya mahali huonyesha mahali.
